title: NRC modeled retrofit — brick veneer over steel-stud wall

facts.text: The study uses hygIRC-2D to model a three-year sequence (one initiation weather year and two critical weather years) for high-rise masonry wall retrofit configurations.

The paper identifies a brick-veneer/steel-stud base wall and figures four retrofit options (two interior, one exterior, and one air-sealing option); it simulates the wall in the Ottawa-Gatineau National Capital Region.
facts.locator: PDF pp. 3, 6–7; article Abstract, §3 and Fig. 1

facts.text: The authors describe these simulations as a way to identify potentially problematic retrofit strategies for additional laboratory testing or field demonstration.

limitations: Three wall-type cases share one simulation paper; simulated results are not measurements, project approval or technical certification.
